meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 财务和投资分析师、律师助理与法律助手在撰写金融研报或分析法律文档时，必用此技能！基于解析文档一键生成事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡与行动红卡。自动完成深度剖析与风险排查，产出100%可溯源的结构化四色报告，让复杂分析高效且严谨。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析文档,生成四色分析卡,让复杂金融与法律分析高效严谨
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速梳理金融研报或法律文档中的事实与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn complex documents into structured four-color analysis reports for finance and law.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down financial reports or legal documents into key facts and risks.

howto.what: Claude 会把解析好的结构化文档转成四张卡片：蓝卡记事实并附来源片段，绿卡说明机制与背景，黄卡列风险与不确定性，红卡给下一步建议。每张卡片都留痕，来源缺失的事实会标注「无来源」。
howto.when: 当你提供密卷房解析产出的 markdown 结构化文档并提出分析意图时触发。LLM 不可用时会降级到规则引擎生成卡片，黄卡、红卡会标注「未启用 LLM」。

say.text: 根据这份文档生成四色卡片
say.note: 产出蓝、绿、黄、红四张卡片

say.text: 只跑 extract 阶段，先给我事实蓝卡
say.note: 单独输出事实抽取结果

say.text: 把文档里没有来源的地方标出来
say.note: 蓝卡中标注「无来源」，不生成断言

howto.what_en: Claude turns a parsed structured document into four cards: a blue card of sourced facts, a green card explaining mechanism and background, a yellow card of risks and uncertainty, and a red card of next-step suggestions. Every card is traceable, and facts without a source are marked as unsourced.
howto.when_en: Use when you provide a markdown document produced by doc parsing along with an analysis goal. If the LLM is unavailable, it falls back to a rule engine and marks the yellow and red cards as not LLM-generated.

say_en.text: Generate four-color cards from this document
say_en.note: Produces blue, green, yellow, red cards

say_en.text: Run only the extract stage and give me the fact blue card
Flag the places in the document that have no source
say_en.note: Marks them unsourced, no assertions made
